truth: APP-01A-E are landed in canonical main. PR #45 merged at canonical main 1b2b008dbbc830524ad7d149fd287bfd4b82f286 and APP-01 is closed as a construction dependency only, not as OS-package/customer/release acceptance.
Historical stacked PRs #1-#43 remain provenance receipts; cumulative APP-01A-D landed via #44 and APP-01E landed via #45. They are not new merge targets.

Global reselection considered every dependency-ready product node rather than repository/file adjacency. DAW-00, AUDIO-01, AUDIO-02 and OPS-04 are mechanically eligible/preserved, but UX-01 is selected because it is the phase-3 consumer bottleneck that turns completed APP/CORE foundations into the Artist/Song front door and unlocks SONG-01.
UX-01 is ACTIVE at bounded increment UX-01A: Artist Headquarters Front Door + context-safe navigation.
UX-01A exact baseline is canonical main 1b2b008dbbc830524ad7d149fd287bfd4b82f286.

Binding design invariants come from AUDIT-DESIGN and REQ-SCOPE-142: N0TE opens as Artist Headquarters; Song/current job/state are primary; artist language replaces developer plumbing; progressive disclosure protects creative attention; empty/loading/offline/unavailable/stale/failure/recovery states must be understandable/actionable; navigation must preserve meaningful Artist/Song context.

REQ-SCOPE-096 requires artist-first progressive onboarding: the artist can start/continue a Song before understanding N0TE or configuring DAWs/AI/providers. External/provider setup stays contextual and skippable until needed.

REQ-SCOPE-143 requires fresh-profile isolation and non-destructive preservation: no profile may inherit another Artist's identity/tastes/catalog/history/workflow/goals, and imported/external material cannot grant product authority.
UX-01A will expose existing ApplicationProfiles, ApplicationRuntime and canonical Headquarters/Song state rather than creating a competing consumer data model.

The presentation choice for UX-01A is a dependency-light loopback-only standards-based local web shell. This is a reversible implementation detail, not a permanent framework/product-identity decision; later native packaging may embed or replace the presentation layer without changing product semantics.

UX-01A normal consumer outcome is bounded: healthy first-profile creation/selection, launch into Artist Headquarters, clear no-Song versus active-Song state, Start a Song, Resume the current Song, navigate between bounded Headquarters surfaces without losing selected Artist/Song context, and explicit Quit that closes Headquarters/releases runtime and shell ownership.
Primary UI must not display raw profile/Song IDs, JSON, capability registry/provider/debug/transport/stack traces. Advanced/debug surfaces are outside UX-01A.

UX-01A is local-first and must not connect DAWs, AI or external providers merely to render the shell. No remote call, paid fallback, consequential external action or held future service is authorized by this increment.

Basic accessibility is part of the first shell, not cleanup: semantic landmarks/labels, keyboard operation, visible focus, non-color-only state, reduced-motion respect, comfortable targets and readable scaling are required within the bounded surfaces.

The shell transport must remain loopback-only, deny cross-origin write authority, and bind write actions to the exact shell session; browser reachability must not create a localhost CSRF or network-listening control plane.

UX-01A does not close UX-01. Focus modes, Job/Approval Center, broad Creative Studio canvas, visual fixture system, responsiveness budgets and the full UX/design contract remain later UX-01 increments after this front door is proven.
Hosted execution evidence remains evidence only when actually observed. Authored/static proof must not be relabeled as executed proof.
